thesis: The speakers argue that children should start thinking about money and investing early because the human brain is optimally set up to specialize in activities between the ages of 10 and 20. They illustrate this point by citing examples of Bill Gates learning to code, Michelangelo learning sculpture, and Warren Buffett buying his first stock at age 11, while also noting that Kevin and Justin have been practicing investing since they were very young.
